children: RNS Number : 6334S  AB Dynamics PLC  01 September 2026
Further to the announcement on 1 July, Ed Haycock has today been appointed to the Board as Group Finance Director.

As previously announced, Richard Hickinbotham stood down from the Board as a Non-Executive Director on 31 August 2026, having served for nine years. Julie Armstrong has replaced Richard as Remuneration Committee Chair
Andrew Lewis, Interim Chief Financial Officer
Peel Hunt LLP (Nominated Adviser and Joint Broker)
The person responsible for arranging the release of this information is Miles Ingrey-Counter, Company Secretary.
AB Dynamics is a leading designer, manufacturer and supplier of advanced testing, simulation and measurement products and services to the global transport market.

AB Dynamics is an international group of companies headquartered in Bradford on Avon. AB Dynamics currently supplies all the major automotive manufacturers, Tier 1 suppliers and service providers, who routinely use the Group's products to test and verify vehicle safety systems and dynamics.
